title: 세수추계위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 세수추계위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 8 (Allowances, etc.) Allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses may be paid, within the budget, to advisory group members, relevant public officials, experts, and other persons who attend meetings of the Committee, its subcommittees, or advisory group, or submit opinions on agenda items: Provided, That no such payment shall be made to a public official who attends a meeting or submits opinions on an agenda item in direct connection with the official's assigned duties.
